objective: Add session-rotated fair exposure and creator diversity to fullscreen Public Wall videos while retaining immediate tapped playback, ad slots, pagination and signed-media protections.
status: DEV source only, not a staging or production release
protections: Only already-authorized public video metadata is re-ordered inside newly loaded 15-row pages; no extra RPC, network calls, schema, RLS or impressions writes
Original clicked video, existing playlist rows and ad slot positions remain stable after append
Newest-only keyset cursor remains based on server order; Latest/Following Wall presentation and existing For You remain unchanged
No changes to AdMob fill, consent, cooldown, native IMA, player lifecycle, prefetch, swipe, gestures, reactions or signed URLs
limitations: Low engagement is only a proxy for underexposure; exact equal view counts are not guaranteed without authenticated privacy-safe view analytics
Fair opportunity is within the fetched 50-video window, not the entire historical archive
requiredGates: Node pure ranking and fullscreen source contract tests
Full TypeScript and protected ad/nav/media/spacing CI gates
Android Hermes native ad/playback and gesture smoke on exact staging APK/OTA
Explicit DEV to RC to production promotion after exact update/runtime evidence; no release by this change alone

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Fullscreen playlist now locally ranks authorized metadata before appending new rows; preserve startup, Android video lifetime and preload.
preservedBehaviors: Expo Video playback, Android native dependencies, private media and network retry remain unchanged

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Fair video ordering operates within the authenticated Public Wall modal and must not override account/location transitions or close/reopen session cancellation.
preservedBehaviors: Current clicked video first, session guard, account/location isolation, ads and modal close/back navigation

productionBaselineEvidence: Inspected canonical main 0ee57887c991d23472cdf1f9b849bce945792910 and latest stacked DEV fullscreen swipe/reaction source 0c461c451ce58b5d8211da46b511f6f9e43df016. GitHub source, not verified installed Android APK, RC OTA, runtime, ad fill or production.
chosenApproach: Rank only each freshly authorized 15-video metadata batch in memory by 30% fresh, 30% low-engagement and 40% general discovery lanes, rotating deterministically per viewing session and avoiding recent creators; then append without moving existing rows.
selectionRationale: Does not require view tracking, backend queries, schema, permissions or extra media downloads. Ranking before ad insertion preserves consent/first-view ad behavior, stable swipe index and signed media recovery. Account/session guards reject late results.
preserveBehaviors: Currently viewed video remains at its index and original tapped video starts fullscreen
Chronological keyset cursor and 50-entry cap unchanged; Latest and Following Wall feeds unchanged
IMA and AdMob consent and revenue placements remain untouched
Source authorization, video prefetch, playback retries, signed URLs and account isolation remain unchanged
acceptanceChecks: Node tests cover complete unique videos, fresh/low-engagement opportunity, creator cooldown, deterministic viewer/session variation and stable existing playlist
Integrated source tests verify original tapped video, keyset cursor, append-only playlist and unchanged ad insertion
No new RPC, point transaction, downloaded media, sensitive analytics or permission change
Release requires exact-head full TypeScript, native Android playback, ad fill, dashboard and signed media checks and validated staging RC
alternativeApproaches: Randomize entire existing fullscreen list on every swipe (rejected: would jump current player, ads and scroll index)
Use global lifetime view counts immediately (deferred: no verified privacy-safe authenticated impression store and would add backend/write load)
Re-fetch and re-sign many historical videos to compute ranks (rejected: expensive, slow and increased bandwidth risk)
